Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial `oo-googledocs` skill release for operating Google Docs through an OOMOL-connected account via the `oo` CLI.
- Supports document discovery and retrieval, including search, full document fetch by ID, and best-effort plain-text extraction.
- Provides document creation and copying actions, including blank documents and documents with initial text.
